name: PTSD Chihuahua
look: A close-up of a wide-eyed chihuahua staring blankly at the camera, blended in a faded double exposure with old war scenes: military helicopters flying overhead and soldiers walking through tall grass.
use: Shows someone hit by sudden flashbacks to a bad experience. The caption names a trigger, like a sound, phrase or place, that sends the person straight back to a past ordeal such as a group project, a bad job or a brutal exam.
slots: the trigger, as a caption above the dog: the sound, phrase or situation that brings back a bad memory
examples: When the teacher says "pick your own partners"
Hearing my old alarm ringtone on someone else's phone
